In email-manager.ts, sendAddGuestsEmails branches on `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`: a listed email receives `AttendeeScheduledEmail` (a full 'scheduled' invitation) instead of `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`. Since the schema doesn't enforce uniqueness against existing attendees (only within the list), a caller can pass an existing attendee's email alongside a new one, causing a spurious re-invitation email to that attendee. Verifiable from the diff lines `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` and the `newGuests.includes(...)` branch; passing `uniqueGuests` would be the fix.
